name: zviryatko/drupal-react-scaffold-theme
description: Base theme for React islands built as core Single Directory Components, with a shared Vite/Jest config for subthemes.

suggest.drupal/paragraphs: Paragraph types as blocks of the page builder, with the Paragraphs Library for reused ones (recipe react_scaffold_builder_paragraphs)
suggest.drupal/entity_usage: Shows where media, paragraphs and saved blocks are used by layouts (recipe react_scaffold_builder_paragraphs)
suggest.drupal/metatag: Meta tags on landing pages, filled by the AI assistant on request (recipe react_scaffold_builder_seo)
suggest.drupal/ai: The AI assistant of the page builder (recipe react_scaffold_builder_ai)
